summary.description: One to three sentences: what the PR changes, the surfaces you reviewed, and the overall risk.

findings.description: Concrete problems that should change this PR, most important first. Empty when there are none, which is the usual result. Never more than 8.

file.description: Path exactly as listed in pr-files.txt.

line.description: Added or changed line in the PR's version of the file where GitHub can place an inline review comment.

problem.description: What is wrong, the input or state that triggers it, and why it matters.

tldr.description: One to three sentences the author can read instead of `problem` and `fix`: what breaks, and what to change.

action_items.description: One to three short imperative steps that resolve the finding, most important first. Never more than 3.

rule.description: Path of the rule doc this violates, or null.

previous_id.description: The id of the finding in previous-review.json this repeats, or null for a new finding.

resolved.description: Findings from previous-review.json that no longer apply. Empty when there are none.

id.description: The earlier finding's id, such as F1.

status.description: fixed: the code no longer has the problem. dismissed: a reply explained why it is not a problem, and the code bears that out. withdrawn: on your own second look, it was never a real problem.

reason.description: One sentence: the change that fixed it, the reply that settled it and its author, or why it was not a problem.

notes.description: Optional non-blocking observations, one sentence each. Usually empty. Never more than 5.

file.description: Path exactly as listed in pr-files.txt.
